In Figure 26(a), the relationship between load and predicted PUE is examined across three different ambient temperatures: 17°C, 27°C, and 35°C. The results indicate that as the system load increases from 4 to 6 kW, the predicted PUE decreases, reaching a minimum value at 6 kW, which is the design load of the system. Beyond 6 kW, the predicted PUE begins to rise slightly, indicating that the system operates most efficiently at its design load. This trend emphasizes that a lower PUE is achieved optimally at a load of 6 kW, with only minor variations across different T .
